_about: Every gameplay number lives here. Speeds in m/s, times in seconds, wobble from 0 (steady) to 1 (a kid falls out).

slippery._about: patchSeconds null = the mess stays for the whole job

things._about: how things behave on the mess and in your hands

events._about: timed events per job (seconds after the start)

suspicion._about: the "?" meter each grown-up has for each coat, 0..1 per second; full = THAT'S NOT A GROWN-UP!

heat._about: Heat for the whole job: points from busts and shouts; level = how many thresholds are passed (0 Calm, 1 Twitchy, 2 Alert, 3 Panic). Several grown-ups catching you in the same moment (within sameIncident seconds) count as one incident: the first adds 'bust', the others 'bustSameIncident'.

closingTime._about: seconds into the job, then one section every sectionEvery seconds, with a warning first

gadgetsOnCoat._about: what gadget effects do to a coat (friendly fire)

loot._about: pockets hold this many small pieces; big loot slows you by perKg (down to minSpeed of normal); every drop loses dropLoss of the value, never below minValue of the original

rescue._about: solo players get spareKids per run instead of friends; a Spare Kid comes in at the player spawn as one kid. gateReach = how close you must be to open the cage.
